bug_semantics: Archive extraction trusted attacker-controlled archives.FileInfo.LinkTarget values. The default, strip, and filtered handlers passed those values to os.Symlink without proving that the link resolved beneath the extraction root, so a crafted relative target such as ../../../../etc/shadow could create an escaping symlink and later archive entries could read or overwrite files outside the destination.
flaw_origin: The first reconstructable public commit that wrote Zarf's vulnerable custom extraction handler is PR #3732 member 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11. It added src/pkg/archive/archive.go and its default unarchive handler, including filepath.Join(dst, f.LinkTarget) followed by os.Symlink with no containment validation. Its immediate parent 4fc1783af6eb18e54f6ed91766388672204dd281 had no src/pkg/archive/archive.go and still delegated decompression to mholt/archiver/v3; later commit 527bad4fda8fc665b75c1cdf43757f5194e4c69b expanded the same unsafe mechanism to strip and filtered handlers but did not originate it.
ai_marker: absent: the BIC commit object 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11 has human author and committer Kit Patella <kit@defenseunicorns.com>; its message is 'make linter happy, apply brandt's unarchive impl spike' with only Signed-off-by: Kit Patella <kit@defenseunicorns.com>, and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker.
evidence: The assigned GHSA bundle describes CVE-2026-29064/GHSA-hcm4-6hpj-vghm as symlink-target path traversal in src/pkg/archive/archive.go, affecting >= 0.54.0 and < 0.73.1 and patched in 0.73.1; CVE.org returned state PUBLISHED with the same affected range.

GitHub PR #3732 exposes five public member commits: fdfe01bd5a2302074ce4fca0d6e5c3453b19b457, 4fc1783af6eb18e54f6ed91766388672204dd281, 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11, 7c5cdf95f32dde5f24cf2be740f23a164735fd7c, and 9f3eeb8a0d5c65f8d72e240643cf522693c50cf9; GitHub squashed them into landed commit 7352f33964002080f35b277d900ac9c2a6f883f0.

The public commit object for 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11 reports the single parent 4fc1783af6eb18e54f6ed91766388672204dd281 and adds src/pkg/archive/archive.go. Its new handler lines 124-127 join dst with f.LinkTarget and call os.Symlink without a containment check.

Direct parent-tree verification: the 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11 diff marks src/pkg/archive/archive.go ADDED from parent 4fc1783af6eb18e54f6ed91766388672204dd281; that parent's archive implementation delegates Decompress to archiver.Unarchive and contains none of the vulnerable custom LinkTarget/os.Symlink lines.

Targeted git -S history in src/pkg/archive/archive.go starts the vulnerable f.LinkTarget and os.Symlink mechanism at landed squash 7352f33964002080f35b277d900ac9c2a6f883f0; commit 527bad4fda8fc665b75c1cdf43757f5194e4c69b later added strip/filter variants, while its parent already retained the default vulnerable handler.

Release ancestry checks show landed introducer 7352f33964002080f35b277d900ac9c2a6f883f0 is not an ancestor of v0.53.0 but is an ancestor of v0.54.0 and v0.73.0, matching the advisory's >=0.54.0 affected boundary.

Landed fix 93f9c33a9d4724ea3fa51d09a69e8b7f8525dc57 replaces direct os.Symlink handlers with os.Root-confined operations plus validateSymlink, rejecting absolute/rooted/volume targets and any path resolving to .. or ../ beneath the link parent.

PR #4674 atomic fix 11c7123dbedfc47af90880fe40e1e81ea2bf7835 and landed squash 93f9c33a9d4724ea3fa51d09a69e8b7f8525dc57 both produce stable patch-id 0ee85db3c81021d02b6fbeba680572ce5d59bb09, proving direct-fix equivalence.
Tag v0.73.1 resolves to release commit fb742df35c5f7b76afe11295d619b7a737f8bdcd, whose parent is fix 93f9c33a9d4724ea3fa51d09a69e8b7f8525dc57; the fix is absent from v0.73.0 and present in v0.73.1.
reasoning: The vulnerability is real and published: untrusted archive metadata reached symlink creation without destination-root containment. Decomposing PR #3732 avoids misclassifying its landed squash aggregate: 92b743d02930ce33571889fa585fb859bf2ebc11 is the smallest public member that first wrote the vulnerable custom handler, while its verified parent lacks those lines; later handler refactors merely preserved or broadened the same flaw. The landed squash enters the first affected v0.54.0 release. PR #4674 member 11c7123dbedfc47af90880fe40e1e81ea2bf7835 directly replaces the unsafe mechanism, is patch-identical to landed fix 93f9c33a9d4724ea3fa51d09a69e8b7f8525dc57, and that landed fix is included in v0.73.1. The BIC commit object is human-authored and human-committed and contains no AI marker, so under BIC-only attribution the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
